initial_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

scenario_definition.name: Full-input control (k=0); intended use: Spring section (Sezione primavera)
scenario_definition.initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people. I prefer a property in energy class C or better. I prefer properties near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.
clarifications.D: I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten.

clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class C or better.

requirements.description: Energy class C or better (A1 through C). Only the energy class requirement is in scope; the 180 sqm floor area, 14-child capacity, Turin location, and public transport proximity are outside the energy-efficiency filter scope.
The user explicitly wants the building near public transport. Per the 75th percentile (70.93), rounded to 71.
The spring section must be integrated into an existing kindergarten, so proximity to existing education facilities is a convenience need. Per the 75th percentile (75.14), rounded to 75.
The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area >= 180 is applied.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters the estates by the extracted requirements only: surface_area of at least 180 sqm, energy_class in A1 through C, mobility score of at least 71, education score of at least 75, and within 3.0 km of the given coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance from those coordinates, nearest first. No LIMIT is applied.
